name: Suiso ~1/2 no Kiseki~
source:
Main character who attends newspaper club matures along with the girls at school. He starts to see in them what he could not see. He starts to know them from the sides unknown before. Wait... what does he even know about girls?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
参加报社的主角与学校里的女孩们一起成长。他开始在他们身上看到他看不到的东西。他开始从以前未知的方面认识他们。等等……他对女孩子了解多少？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
